title: Package-level otel.Tracer() global caused dropped annotation spans
answers: Why are annotation app traces/spans missing in Grafana?
Annotation spans not showing up in tracing backend
Tracer created with otel.Tracer() at package init doesn't emit spans
body:
Symptom: annotation app spans (annotation.k8s.*, annotation.store.*, annotation.authz.*) were missing/no-op in the tracing backend even though tracing was configured.
Root cause: pkg/registry/apps/annotation/tracing.go declared `var tracer = otel.Tracer(...)` at package init time; this resolved the global TracerProvider before Grafana's real (lazy-loaded) TracerProvider was registered, so the captured tracer stayed a no-op.
Fix pattern: delete the package-level tracer var and thread a `trace.Tracer` explicitly as a constructor/function parameter (AppInstaller.tracer, k8sRESTAdapter.tracer, instrumentedStore.tracer, dashboardFolderResolver.tracer, and as an explicit param to canAccessAnnotation(s), resolveDashboardFolders, newSearchHandler, newTagsHandler, newGraphiteHandler), sourced from the app's tracing.Tracer dependency at wiring time.
Constraints: applies whenever a package initializes its own otel tracer at var-init time instead of receiving one from DI; not needed if the tracer is obtained lazily inside each call via otel.Tracer() at call time (that pattern does resolve correctly), only the package-level var form is the problem.
applies: pkg/registry/apps/annotation package, and any other package using a package-level `var tracer = otel.Tracer(...)` initialized before the real TracerProvider is set
